description.narrative:
• The objective of the project is to contribute to the economic growth of the country by providing sustainable electricity supply required by the national development plan for the sector to contribute to increasing overall access rate to electricity from 30% at the end of 2018 to 100% by 2030.
• The specific objectives are o to integrate the national electricity grid and to increase the capabilities of the electricity transmission grid ensuring the lowest cost of reliable energy supply in southern Mozambique in support of electricity supply security, local economic development and regional power export opportunities by enabling timely evacuation of power from the Temane CTT IPP o Create the first phase of an important transmission network infrastructure to unlock economic and social development, o Realising economic return (through dividends from investment) on strategic public-sector participation in the generation initiative o Contributing to building skills/capacity in EDM and enhancing Mozambique’s reputation as a major regional electricity player
